title: Sacred Telangana: 5 Days Through Its Most Blessed Temples
card_points: The state’s most revered temples in one circuit
overview: From Charminar’s storied streets in Hyderabad to Ramappa’s UNESCO-listed masterwork, this five-day circuit brings together Telangana’s most revered shrines — hilltop temples, riverside sanctuaries and Kakatiya-era stone masterpieces.

You’ll travel in a private vehicle with a tour manager, with darshan times planned around temple schedules and all meals taken care of. It’s a well-paced journey for families, senior travellers and first-time pilgrims alike.

highlights.title: Yadadri
highlights.text: Lakshmi Narasimha cave shrine, rebuilt in white stone and gold

highlights.title: Basar
highlights.text: Gnana Saraswati Temple on the banks of the Godavari

highlights.title: Kondagattu
highlights.text: Forest hilltop shrine of Swayambhu Anjaneya Swamy

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hyderabad
itinerary.subtitle: Heritage & local exploration · Overnight: Hyderabad
itinerary.intro: Arrive by 3:00 PM, meet your vehicle and tour manager, and check in. The afternoon is spent exploring the city’s landmarks.

activities.title: Charminar & Laad Bazaar
activities.text: The 1591 CE monument and the bangle bazaar around it.

activities.title: Hussain Sagar
activities.text: The heart-shaped lake (1563 CE) with a monolithic Buddha at its centre.

activities.title: Birla Mandir
activities.text: White marble Vaishnava temple on a 280-ft granite hill.

activities.title: Dinner & overnight stay
activities.text: Hyderabad.

activities.title: Drive to Swarnagiri
activities.text: The “Golden Mountain” hilltop shrine with views over the Deccan plains.

activities.title: Swarnagiri darshan
activities.text: Around three hours at the temple.

activities.title: Lunch
activities.text: Near Swarnagiri.

activities.title: Yadadri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple
activities.text: Cave shrine atop a granite hill, recently rebuilt in white stone and gold.

activities.title: Drive to Nizamabad
activities.text: Dinner and overnight stay.

activities.title: Drive to Basar
activities.text: A scenic route along the Godavari.

activities.title: Gnana Saraswati Temple
activities.text: South India’s best-known Saraswati temple, famed for Vidyarambham ceremonies.

activities.title: Lunch
activities.text: In Basar.

activities.title: Kondagattu Anjaneya Swamy Temple
activities.text: Forest hilltop shrine to the self-manifested Hanuman, Jagtial district.

activities.title: Drive to Karimnagar
activities.text: Dinner and overnight stay.

activities.title: Drive to Warangal
activities.text: Former capital of the Kakatiya dynasty.

activities.title: Thousand Pillar Temple
activities.text: Star-shaped 12th-century temple with intricately carved pillars.

activities.title: Warangal Fort
activities.text: Stone gateways (Kakatiya Kala Thoranam) and fort ruins.

activities.title: Bhadrakali Temple
activities.text: Hilltop temple overlooking Bhadrakali Lake. Dinner and overnight stay.

activities.title: Ramappa Temple, Palampet
activities.text: UNESCO-listed 13th-century Kakatiya temple, renowned for its sculpture.

activities.title: Lunch & return drive
activities.text: Head back towards Hyderabad.

activities.title: Drop-off in Hyderabad
activities.text: Tour concludes.

good_to_know.title: Dress code
good_to_know.text: Traditional or modest clothing is recommended at all temples. Footwear is removed before entering.

good_to_know.title: What to carry
good_to_know.text: A valid photo ID, comfortable walking shoes, a water bottle and any regular medication.

good_to_know.title: Physical activity
good_to_know.text: Some shrines involve steps or hill climbs. Tell us about mobility needs and we’ll plan accordingly.

good_to_know.title: Best time to visit
good_to_know.text: October to March offers pleasant weather. Festival dates may affect crowds and darshan times.

faqs.question: Where does the tour start and end?
faqs.answer: The tour starts and ends in Hyderabad. Please plan to arrive by 3:00 PM on Day 1.

faqs.question: Can the itinerary be customised?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can add or skip temples, change hotel categories, or extend your stay. Share your preferences when you enquire.

faqs.question: Is this tour suitable for senior citizens?
faqs.answer: Yes. Travel is by private vehicle and the pace is comfortable. Tell us about any mobility needs in advance.

faqs.question: Are special darshan tickets included?
faqs.answer: No, special darshan tickets are not included, but our team can help you book them where available.
